name: UPLAPO100XOHR
summary: Plan apochromat oil objective with NA 1.50, which Evident describes as among the first plan-corrected apochromats at that aperture. It is intended for live-cell super-resolution, TIRF and single-molecule work.

sources.title: Evident: Objectives for TIRF imaging
Evident: 100X objective NA 1.5 WD 0.12 mm (spec page)

name: UPLAPO60XOHR
summary: 60x plan apochromat oil objective with NA 1.50, the lower-magnification partner of the UPLAPO100XOHR. Evident suggests it for live-cell super-resolution and whole-cell TIRF imaging.

sources.title: Evident: Objectives for TIRF imaging

name: UAPON100XOTIRF
summary: Earlier Olympus 100x oil TIRF objective, now discontinued; Evident names it as the previous model of the UPLAPO100XOHR. It was used in published TIRF studies of membrane dynamics.

sources.title: Evident: Objectives for TIRF imaging
Evident: UAPON 100XOTIRF (discontinued product page)

name: APON100XHOTIRF
summary: TIRF objective with an unusually high NA of 1.70 that requires a special immersion oil. Evident pitches it at single-molecule work such as photobleaching-based subunit counting.

sources.title: Evident: Objectives for TIRF imaging
Evident: APON-TIRF/UAPON-TIRF/UPLAPO-HR

name: UAPON150XOTIRF
summary: High-magnification 150x oil TIRF objective with NA 1.45. Evident lists it for subcellular imaging of organelles, the endoplasmic reticulum and vesicle trafficking.

sources.title: Evident: Objectives for TIRF imaging

name: UPLSAPO60XS2
summary: Super apochromat that uses silicone oil, whose refractive index Evident matches to that of live cells and tissue, to limit aberrations and keep 3D shapes accurate. It has a correction collar for coverslip thickness.

sources.title: Evident: UPLSAPO60XS2
Evident: UPLSAPO-S/UPLSAPO-W series

summary: X Line extended apochromat water-immersion objective with NA 1.2 and a 26.5 mm field number. It transmits from the UV (340 nm) into the near infrared.

sources.title: Evident: UPLXAPO60XW

name: XLPLN25XWMP2
summary: Water-immersion 25x objective from Evident's multiphoton (MP) range, pairing NA 1.05 with a 2 mm working distance. It can be used with or without a coverslip.

sources.title: Evident: XLSLPLN25XGMP

summary: Higher-NA member of ASI's multi-immersion range for cleared-tissue light-sheet microscopy, keeping a 10 mm working distance in any immersion medium from RI 1.33 to 1.56. Its NA and magnification scale with the medium's refractive index.

name: Mesolens
summary: Custom large objective that combines a 6 mm field of view with an NA of 0.47, giving sub-cellular lateral resolution across large embryos and tissue volumes. It was described by McConnell and colleagues in 2016.

sources.title: McConnell et al. (2016) A novel optical microscope for imaging large embryos and tissue volumes with sub-cellular resolution throughout. eLife 5:e18659
